How we work

A clear purpose. An agreed role. A practical way forward.

You can begin with a specific question, an opportunity or a business challenge. Together, we define the work, the contribution SetuHashi will make and how we will assess progress.

Getting started

Start with what you want to achieve.

You do not need to arrive with a fully developed brief. Tell us what you are considering, what is proving difficult or what you would like to improve.

  1. 1

    Understand the situation

    We discuss your objectives, existing capabilities, constraints and the decisions ahead.

  2. 2

    Define a useful assignment

    We agree on the scope, outputs, responsibilities and timing with you, and confirm the role, fees and next steps before work begins. You can start with one focused piece of work.

  3. 3

    Decide how to proceed

    Further work is a separate choice. An assessment may lead to action, a revised direction or a decision not to pursue the opportunity.
